risk_note: F1-08fe: admin navigation only (apps/admin/src/pages/{ledger,adjustments,withdrawals}/**, texts/{ledger,adjustments}.ts). Ledger rows link by AdminLedgerEntry.link, user card links to user detail, adjustment / reversal / write-off success notices link to a prefilled ledger query, and the write-off frozen-pending notice links to the withdrawals list filtered by user; ledger and withdrawals pages read the prefill from the query string. No new write request, no write body or amount display change; the pending badge was not built (no existing read gives the count). Rule tests and spec-test by independent Claude contexts; money-type review by an independent Claude (D10-2003); implementation by Opus 5.5. Written by hand.
